title: Growing Up Gilead: How ‘The Testaments’ Brings a “Beautiful Darkness” to ‘The Handmaid’s Tale’ Universe (Exclusive)
summary: In a dramatic departure from its predecessor, Hulu and MGM's coming-of-age next Margaret Atwood adaptation feels significantly lighter, even bordering on whimsical — before the cracks of resistance emerge: "There’s nothing in the world as powerful as a 14-year-old girl," says creator Bruce Miller.
